mapper.sql: select plan_id, aql_level, code_letter, sample_size, ac_val, re_val, inspect_level, batch_min, batch_max, status, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from qms_aql_plan
mapper.select: where aql_level = #{aqlLevel} and code_letter = #{codeLetter} and inspect_level = #{inspectLevel} and del_flag = '0' and status = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into qms_aql_plan(aql_level, code_letter, sample_size, ac_val, re_val, inspect_level, batch_min, batch_max, status, del_flag, create_by, create_time, remark) values(#{aqlLevel}, #{codeLetter}, #{sampleSize}, #{acVal}, #{reVal}, #{inspectLevel}, #{batchMin}, #{batchMax}, #{status}, '0', #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.delete: update qms_aql_plan set del_flag = '1' where plan_id in #{planId}
